tour.$description: Guided-tour card geometry and spotlight. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

spotlight-padding.$description: Breathing room between the spotlighted target and the edge of the cut-out. Read at runtime (it shapes a clip-path), so it must stay a plain px length.

spotlight-corner.$description: Corner of the spotlight cut-out. A plain px length for the same reason as spotlight-padding: the cut-out is a clip-path path computed in script.
